# HarborStack (fictional vendor brief)

**Product:** Multi-cloud orchestration with policy-as-code add-ons.
**List price (demo):** $5,100 / month for comparable 40 vCPU / 160 GB capacity, plus $600 for policy pack.
**Support:** 24×7 phone for severity-1; 1-hour response target on enterprise plan.
**Strengths (from brief):** Multi-region failover; richer observability export; SOC2 Type II report available on request.
**Weaknesses (from brief):** Higher list price; onboarding requires a paid professional-services kickoff ($8,000 one-time in brief).
**Contract notes:** Month-to-month after 90 days; data egress fees apply above 2 TB/month.
**Evidence label:** Supplied demo fixture only — not a real vendor.
